summary: Phase 11.7 Lifetime Unlimited tier testing completed. CRITICAL DATABASE SCHEMA BUG prevents full functionality. Frontend UI is correctly implemented. Backend code logic is correct but cannot execute due to database constraint violation.

critical_bugs.issue: Database CHECK constraint on profiles.subscription_status does not include 'pro_lifetime_unlimited'
critical_bugs.impact: BLOCKS ALL FUNCTIONALITY - Users cannot be upgraded to pro_lifetime_unlimited tier via any method (Stripe webhook, ClickFunnels webhook, or manual admin update)
critical_bugs.sql_fix: ALTER TABLE public.profiles DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS profiles_subscription_status_check; ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD CONSTRAINT profiles_subscription_status_check CHECK (subscription_status IN ('free','pro_monthly','pro_lifetime','pro_lifetime_unlimited'));
